name: filter-keys
intro: The 23 operators and 557 filter keys a filter group accepts in OpenCTI 7.261119.0, in the API and in the filter menu of the interface. [Filters](/develop/apis/filters/) explains how to write a filter group.

sections.title: Operators
sections.text: A filter is `{key, values, operator, mode}`; `operator` defaults to `eq` and `mode` (`or`, `and`) combines the values. The interface offers an operator for a key from the key's value type. In stream, trigger and playbook filters, every key also accepts `has_changed`, `not_has_changed`.

cells: The text contains the value. In stream, trigger and playbook filters, also for: long text.
The text ends with the value. In stream, trigger and playbook filters, also for: long text.
short text, integer, number, boolean, ID, vocabulary value, value from a fixed list
Equals one of the values (mode `or`) or all of them (mode `and`). Without values, the key has no value. In stream, trigger and playbook filters, also for: long text.
Greater than or equal to the value.

The event changed the key (on a creation, the key has a value). Takes no values.
Lower than or equal to the value.
Full-text match of the value on the keys, as the search engine analyzes it.
short text, long text, integer, number, date, ID, vocabulary value, value from a fixed list

The text does not end with the value. In stream, trigger and playbook filters, also for: long text.
short text, integer, number, boolean, ID, vocabulary value, value from a fixed list
Equals none of the values. Without values, the key has a value. In stream, trigger and playbook filters, also for: long text.
Stream, trigger and playbook filters only
The event did not change the key. Takes no values.
short text, long text, integer, number, date, ID, vocabulary value, value from a fixed list

ID with several values, vocabulary value with several values, value from a fixed list with several values
The key does not hold exactly the values.

Full-text search on the words of the value, not an exact match.
The text starts with the value. In stream, trigger and playbook filters, also for: long text.
Search-engine query string, such as `*` for any value.
The date is between the two values, absolute dates or relative ones such as `now-7d` and `now`.

sections.title: Special keys of the filter menu
sections.text: Keys the filter menu offers that are not a plain attribute: the platform resolves them into other filters. "Applies to" names the entity types whose filter menu shows the key.

cells: Entities and observables, with aliases only
**Aliases**. Matches both `aliases` and `x_opencti_aliases`. Value: short text, several values.
**Reliability (self or author)**. The reliability of the element, or the reliability of its author when the element has none. Value: vocabulary value of the vocabulary `reliability_ov`.
**Related entity**. The entities an instance trigger listens to. Value: ID, several values of `Stix-Core-Object`.
**Author of related entity**. Value: ID of `Individual`, `Sector`, `System`, `Organization`. Filters on the field `context_data.created_by_ref_id`.
**Creator of related entity**. Value: ID, several values of `User`. Filters on the field `context_data.creator_ids`. Accepts `@me` for the current user.
**Related entity**. Value: ID, several values of `Stix-Core-Object`, `User`, `Group`. Filters on the field `context_data.id`. Accepts `@me` for the current user.
**Type of related entity**. Value: short text, several values. Filters on the field `context_data.entity_type`.
**Label of related entity**. Value: ID, several values of `Label`. Filters on the field `context_data.labels_ids`.
**Marking of related entity**. Value: ID, several values of `Marking-Definition`. Filters on the field `rel_object-marking.internal_id`.
**Dynamic from**. Relationships whose source matches a filter group. Value: filter group.
**In regards of (dynamic)**. Like `regardingOf`, with the related entities given by a filter group instead of IDs. Value: nested filter. Sub-keys: `relationship_type`, `dynamic`.
**Dynamic to**. Relationships whose target matches a filter group. Value: filter group.
Entities and observables, relationships and sightings
**Is inferred**. Whether an inference rule created the element. Value: boolean.
**Group**. A group of the user who performed the action. Value: ID, several values of `Group`. Filters on the field `group_ids`.
**Organization**. An organization of the user who performed the action. Value: ID, several values of `Organization`. Filters on the field `organization_ids`.
**User**. The user who performed the action. Value: ID, several values of `User`. Filters on the field `user_id`. Accepts `@me` for the current user.
Entities and observables, relationships and sightings
**PIR Score**. The score of an entity in a Priority Intelligence Requirement, with the PIR in the `pir_ids` sub-key. Value: integer.
**In regards of**. Elements that have a relationship of the given types with the given entities. Value: nested filter. Sub-keys: `relationship_type`, `id`.
**Representation**. The text that stands for an element on screen, such as its name or its value. Value: short text, several values.
**Is in group**. Workflow condition on a group of the user who triggers the transition. Value: ID, several values of `Group`. Filters on the field `group_ids`.
Entities and observables, except `Artifact`, `Malware-Analysis`; Relationships and sightings
**Status**. The status of the element. A status template matches every status built from it. Value: ID of `StatusTemplate`.
**Is in organization**. Workflow condition on an organization of the user who triggers the transition. Value: ID, several values of `Organization`. Filters on the field `organization_ids`.
**User is**. Workflow condition on the user who triggers the transition. Value: ID, several values of `User`. Filters on the field `user_id`.
**Workflow status**. The current status of the workflow of a draft. Value: ID, several values of `StatusTemplate`.
The entity types the configuration names
One key per metric attribute declared in `app:schema_metrics`, labeled with the metric name. Value: number.
The types each custom field is attached to
One key per custom field, labeled with the field label. The value type follows the field type: integer, boolean, date, a value from the field options, or short text.

sections.title: Special keys of the API
sections.text: Keys with their own handling that the filter menu does not offer as such: the screens set them (relationship lists, logs, bulk search...) and an API filter group can use them. Operators marked "Not restricted" are not limited by a definition: the API applies the one given.

**Creators**. The users who created the element in the platform. Value: ID, several values. Accepts `@me` for the current user.
**Related type**. Relationships whose source or target has one of the given entity types. Value: short text, several values.
**Entity type**. Matches the type or any of its parent types, such as `Stix-Domain-Object`. Value: short text.
**Source entity**. Relationships whose source is one of the given entities. Value: ID of `Stix-Core-Object`.
**Related entity**. Relationships whose source or target is one of the given entities. Value: ID of `Stix-Core-Object`.
Relationships whose source has the given role, such as `uses_from`.
**Source type**. Relationships whose source has one of the given entity types. Value: short text, several values.

The highest opinion on the element. Filters on the field `opinions_metrics.max`.

The number of opinions on the element. Filters on the field `opinions_metrics.total`.
**Relationship type**. Matches the relationship type or any of its parent types, such as `stix-core-relationship`. Value: short text.
The users, groups or organizations an element with restricted access is shared with.
**Rule**. For inference engine rules. Value: short text.
Elements sighted by one of the given identities or locations.
The reliability of the author of the element.
**Target entity**. Relationships whose target is one of the given entities. Value: ID of `Stix-Core-Object`.
Relationships whose target has the given role, such as `uses_to`.
Sightings whose target is one of the given entities.
**Target type**. Relationships whose target has one of the given entity types. Value: short text, several values.
**User service account**. Whether the user is a service account. Value: boolean.
